_about: The development box as Strata measured it on 2026-10-07 (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-Q4_K_XL, 2x RTX 3080 layer split). Every number has its source.
_usable_vram_gib: 2 x 19.58 GiB, the engine's 'free of 19.58' after the desktop on GPU1
_overhead_gib: 39.16 - cache 24.34 - dense 4.52 - MTP 0.85 - KV window 0.81 - idle 0.43 (CUDA contexts, 2 x 700 MiB reserve, state + scratch)
_ram_other_gb: OS + desktop + dsh/searxng (~10) + engine buffers and pinned KV (~5) + page-cache floor (~5)
_gpu_bw_gbs: RTX 3080 20 GB GDDR6X spec; the split runs one card at a time per token
_cpu_bw_gbs: effective expert-kernel bandwidth band: 4-channel DDR4-2666 reads ~77 GB/s (glmbench/FINDINGS.md); Strata runs its AVX2 path here (no VNNI/VBMI)
_pass_fixed_ms: calibrated: Strata Qwen code run = 30.0 ms per verify window (69.5 T/s x 2.09 tok/window); roofline parts 10.4 ms -> ~20 ms fixed (launches, GPU hand-off, recurrences, sampling)

mtp._mtp: Strata Qwen code run: 4000 tokens, 2922 drafted / 2084 accepted -> 1916 passes; union: distinct experts per extra window token (diffuse routing ~0.85)

_live_adaptivity: proxy -> live: Qwen proxy 77% hit at 34% vs Strata live 86-90%: misses x0.52 at best, x1.0 if no uplift

measured_today_tps._src: tabby/exllamav3 medians from run-*/logs (DSV4 3.04bpw, GLM 3.05bpw, MiMo Yamz 2.64bpw; Qwen 6.05bpw daily driver)

gpu_dense_gb._src: Qwen: engine log 4.52 GiB; DSV4: gguf_inventory of the local Q3_K GGUF (attention 5.41 + shared 1.15 + head ~1.06 + indexer/HC/router 0.5); GLM, MiMo: parameter counts from config.json at ~6-8 bpw (estimates)

mtp_layer_gib._src: Qwen measured (q2_0 experts); targets: one MTP layer's experts at ~2 bpw (256-288 x 25.2M) + its attention, estimate

kv_window_gib._src: Qwen measured (32768 cells x 13 layers fp16); targets: compressed/MLA/SWA caches are small - estimates
